items.title: Yoroll
items.source_text: Yoroll Build playable stories without a game engine Yoroll lets anyone turn stories into playable, cinematic games without coding or a game engine. Start with a script, image, or video clip, then direct the scenes, add player choices, and create branching storylines with different outcomes. AI helps bring everything together into an interactive experience you can share. It's more like directing your own interactive movie than programming a game. Artificial Intelligence Games No-Code

items.source_text: Rankhog Get customers from Reddit on autopilot Rankhog finds people on Reddit asking for what you sell. It reads each subreddit's rules, writes a reply that helps, and posts it from your own account at a human pace. Say yes to each reply, or turn on autopilot. No Reddit account? items.title: Gauth Personal Study Agent
items.source_text: Gauth Personal Study Agent An AI study agent that remembers where you struggle Gauth Personal Study Agent connects the questions you snap, the quizzes you take, and the topics you study into one ongoing picture of how you learn. Instead of starting from scratch each session, it spots the gap behind a mistake, builds a short daily plan around it, and adjusts that plan when you miss a review or master a topic early. Practice comes as flashcards, guided step-by-step walkthroughs, and quizzes, with topic mastery and streaks to show progress. Built into the Gauth app. Android Education Artificial Intelligence Online Learning

items.title: Motionflare
items.source_text: Motionflare Turn your website into a stunning launch video in minutes Motionflare turns your website into a ready-to-share marketing video and brand film in minutes. Paste a URL and it uses your real product screenshots, logo, colors, and copy to create branded motion graphics with music and optional narration. Or switch to Film mode to generate a live-action commercial. Refine the result by chat and export in up to 4K. Marketing Artificial Intelligence Video
